name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.pointsOver_nonempty_of_costs
summary: Apply the operator A of exists_reaches_deep to p^s·x, s = e' − e − Σ cost.

steps.claim: Write e' = e + Σ_I cost + s, and take A of cost Σ_I cost raising depths along I (exists_reaches_deep).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨s, rfl⟩, A, R, D⟩ := he.dest, S.exists_reaches_deep I

steps.claim: For every o₄ such that x is deep for o₄: p^s·x ∈ deepElements(S, i, o₄) (it lies over the constant p^{e+s}c).
steps.lean:
have y {o} H : p ^ s • ⟨x, hx.1⟩ ∈ S.deepElements i o :=
    smul_of_tower_mem _ _ ⟨⟨p ^ e • c, by simp [hx.2]⟩, H⟩
steps.typed_fact: p ^ s • ⟨x, hx.1⟩ ∈ S.deepElements i o

steps.claim: p^s x ∈ deepElements(S, i, o₁) (z; its Galois differences have the exponents o₁ of x), and A(p^s x) ∈ deepElements(S, i, o') (D; from depth o by H).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨z, -, D⟩ := y (smul_sub_mem_withExponents hx.2.2.1), D (y hx.2.2.2) o' H

steps.claim: A(p^s x) is the point: projTriv(A(p^s x)) = p^{Σ cost}·projTriv(p^s x) = p^{e'}constantAt(c) (R); its exponents are improvedExponent(o₁, o') (mem_withExponents_of_deep: exponents o₁ by Reaches.mem_of_stable, depth o'); its depth is o'.
steps.lean:
exact ⟨A _, (A _).2, (sub_mem_ker_iff.1 (R z).2).trans (by simp [hx.2]; module),
    mem_withExponents_of_deep (R.mem_of_stable (P := locKisinPart (withExponents ..)) (fun _ ↦
    (·.1)) (nsmul_mem hx.2.2.1 _) z) D, D⟩
